description: We’re Shadowline, final-year CS students from FAST-NUCES Karachi, building for the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge. Our app lets anyone pick a landing site and dates at the Moon’s south pole and instantly see when the Sun is up (power) and when Earth is visible (comms). Existing tools are built for specialists; we want it quick and clear for everyone. We’re a backend, data and AI team, currently building a decentralized AI fact-checking network as our FYP.
